source: Hand-derived on the Singapore ordering: 120 + 10% service = 132, then GST 9% of 132 = 11.88, total 143.88, divided by 4 = 35.97. Adding 19% straight to 120 would give 142.80, which is the common mistake this pins against.

cases.note: 120 bill, 10% service, GST on the subtotal, split 4 ways
no service charge: 100 + GST split 2 ways
